observation: 自制3:2平面内容图。橙墙红屋顶的小屋占中央；两扇蓝窗与蓝门，右后方一棵绿树，前景四柱黄色矮栏，浅蓝天空与绿色地面。保持小屋占比和四周留白。

core_information.depiction: Pale blue sky above a broad muted green ground strip, with the original empty margins.

core_information.source: 中央橙墙与红三角屋顶
core_information.depiction: One squat orange house centered at the same scale, with a broad triangular rust-red roof.
Two separate blue square windows, left and right, with clear wall space between them.

core_information.source: 中间蓝门，下部被栏杆遮挡
core_information.depiction: A central blue door reaching the ground; its lower part is covered by the front yellow rail. Keep the small dark knob on the visible door.

core_information.source: 右后方绿树，树冠左下部被房屋遮挡
core_information.depiction: One round green tree behind the house on the right; the left lower canopy is hidden by the roof and wall. Its visible trunk stands to the right and reaches the ground.
One broad yellow horizontal fence rail joined to four upright posts in front of the lower house and door.

optional_details.importance: 补充天气线索，语义贡献较高
optional_details.depiction: One broad pale cloud at upper left, behind all objects.

optional_details.source: 三角屋顶内两条短横线
optional_details.depiction: Two short coarse horizontal tile strokes inside the red roof.
Three short grass blades in the lower left ground area.

grouping_check: 两档共享房屋、窗门、树、地面和前景栏杆；云、屋顶材质线与草叶按贡献排列。实际层次单独由draw_order记录。
plan_check: 参考稿核对房屋占比、两窗分离、门与地面连接、树在屋后、栏杆在门前及四柱连接。示范内容由本项目独立构造。
